reason: C1 is a bias/clock-side capacitor tied to IB4 and net50; removing it typically only reduces filtering/charge-holding on that bias/clock node and does not break the core differential/latch operation.
impact_estimate: Low (more bias ripple/kickback on IB4/net50; possible small speed/noise penalty).

reason: C0 similarly provides local decoupling/charge storage for IB3 and net18; deleting it usually preserves functionality but reduces bias stabilization and increases susceptibility to transient disturbance.
impact_estimate: Low (increased bias noise on IB3/net18; may degrade metastability margin slightly).

reason: M24 is a diode-connected/stacked NMOS branch on net38 referenced to IB5; if net38 is not a critical internal reference for the main signal path, removing M24 mainly changes bias loading and may slightly shift operating points rather than disabling the latch/sense function.
impact_estimate: Low-to-moderate (bias point/loading on net38/IB5 changes; could affect offset or common-mode range depending on how net38 is used).
